name: diagonal_double_half_hitch
title: Diagonal double half hitch
about: The double half hitch tied on a holding cord laid on a slant: rows of them draw the diagonal lines, diamonds and leaves of macrame. Two half hitches side by side, both turned the same way. Shown loose.

steps.caption: Lay the holding cord on a slant across the work.
Take the working cord over the holding cord, round, and back under it.
Bring it across over its own standing part. That is one half hitch.
Take it over the holding cord again, beside the first hitch, and back under it.
Bring the end over its own crossing part and pull it snug against the first hitch: a double half hitch.
